en.answer: If there are 2 copies of <<11775>> in your Graveyard that were sent there during a previous turn, you can activate both cards' effects in the same turn. (If you target the same monster with both effects, that monster will gain 1600 ATK until the end of your opponent's next turn.)
en.question: If there are 2 copies of <<11775>> in my Graveyard that were sent there during a previous turn, can I activate the second effect of each copy, which increases the ATK and DEF of a targeted "Burning Abyss" monster by 800 until the end of my opponent's turn?
